Important

Before writing this part I have to make it clear. There’s not much to go off of when it comes to Eliasz in this novel. It’s too vague because Remigiusz Mróz doesn’t plan stories ahead, he researches and just writes, he tends to write using these vague statements to later fill them how he wishes. The reason why his version from this novel is the hardest character from the Mrozoverse to scale is because Iwo Eliasz was not even an idea in this novel, he materialised when Mróz was writing “Przewieszenie”.
The Thing
Iwo managed to manipulate Antonina Sznajderman (a woman who survived
Volhynian massacre

) into thinking she has been chosen by God to be teacher of justice so she would manipulate her adopted sons into believing in her justice and so they would begin a crusade of killing Ukrainians which either took part in
Volhynian massacre

or were related to them in Belarus over around 20 years without leaving any traces outside of ancient coins, ultimately rendering the cases cold and each year sent one of these coins he retrieved from their police forces to Witalij Morawczuk a who was a part of UPA and murdered poles in Dolhan under a nickname “Łowotar” and lived under a name Dmitry Leonidow in this very village who Eliasz told them to leave as a final kill.
Morawczuk as Leonidow wrote a work with Doctor Marek Chalimoniuk about life in Dolhan village through the ages.

In 2015 Eliasz and Michał Sznajderman hung Chalimoniuk on Giewont cross without leaving traces besides a tetradrachm in order to misdirect the police from the real leads and a piece of DNA belonging to Michał. He then made sure that the least competent people would work the case by sending anonymous tips to the police like the one for Wiktor Forst about alcoholism
His goal was to remind Polish people about the
Volhynian massacre

and to achieve that he had to make Łowotar’s murder a topic that would be widely talked about in Poland and outside of it and I doubt he could achieve that by just killing Łowotar. That impact could be achieved by having a cop kill Łowotar and since Iwo is obsessed with Wiktor Forst he wanted it to be him.

When Olga Szrebska has interviewed Wiktor Forst about the Giewont murder claimed that it was a suicide. Since Iwo knows that it’s a murder and that Forst is competent enough to notice it’s murder he easily saw through his trap built on the assumption he’ll get angry enough to go after him.

Context: Wiktor Forst has been captured by armed men, but he quickly moved to Russia. The only way Iwo could know this is if he had one of his men watching him and contacting him later, or followed him himself.
Either way, his line of reasoning would look like this:
P1: The men who captured Forst were well armed, driving an unmarked Volkswagen and in suits.
P2: The men were aggressive
P3: Wiktor Forst and Olga Szrebska some time later left Poland through a Russian Border.
C1: The men were government agents sent by a politician supporting their freelance investigation. Those agents were told to act aggressively to fool anybody who could be watching.
P1: A politician was involved in this.
P2: The politician has to support their investigation.
C2: That politician most likely contacted his equivalent in Belarus to check the trace Wiktor and Olga had to discover, since they were already heading to Russia.
P1: Poland and Russia don't have the best relationship, and that's an understatement
P2: Belarus likes to play a mediator between these two countries
C3: The cooperation will most likely be just for show, which means Russia will give Wiktor and Olga info they can't use unless they are forced to.

Iwo decides to either send one of his men to kill a person on the border or do it himself. Knowing that the KGB agents, after finding out about the body and a coin, would interrogate them and expecting that Wiktor would find a way to get out of this situation and convince the KGB to let him access their information about the case.

Coin Misdirection
When Iwo killed Chalimoniuk on Giewont he left in his mouth a tetradrachm.
When he killed a teenage girl he left in her mouth a roman denarius.
On the tetradrachm there was written: “Freedom for Jerusalem”
The roman denarius came from the 1st century after Christ, in the 1st century Rome controlled Jerusalem.
On both coins there are faces of Seleucids related to each other.
All of the coins from the Belarus murders have been found in 1955 in a cave, majority of them came from 1st or 2nd century

‘That year, ceramic vessels containing 561 silver coins were discovered," Vyazmikin continued. "All the containers were stuffed to the brim and secured at the top. The coins mostly dated from the first, perhaps second, century BC. Father Roland de Vaux, the scientist responsible for dating the discoveries, relied on them to determine the period from which the scrolls of Qumran originated. The coins were forged at the mint in Tyre and depict, as you know, Antiochus VII Sidetes, Demetrius II Nicator, Tyrian, and Roman emperors, among others."
They Both nodded.

"Most, however, are from the Seleucids. And these coins appeared from 1991 in Belarus. The murderer used the first tetradrachm here, on Giewont. If he had done it earlier, I might have come up with a solution even without the Roman denarius. But he clinched the matter."

“Okay…” Wiktor replied, pausing. He quickly tried to relate this information to the killer’s motivations. “Why would anyone place coins in the mouths of dead people for over twenty years? And why would they, after all this time, direct the investigation towards a common element?”
“The coins, of course, aren’t originals.”
Forst shook his head, realizing the gravity of this obvious fact.
“Where are these coins?” he asked. “Originals?”
“In various places.”
“And the ones that appeared with the bodies? Is there a place where they can all be seen?”
Vyazmikin thought for a moment. Then a twinkle appeared in his eye.
“In Israel,” he said, rising from his chair. “The originals can be seen in one of the museums.”’
Faking Olga’s death

Before Forst showed up Iwo infiltrated the hospital and injected into her TTX or a similar toxin in order to fake Olga’s heart stopping and then stabbed her in a way so none of the wounds would be lethal. Then he put into her mouth a greek obol. After Forst came and the staff seen and examined Olga’s body it got sent for further examination to the Department of Forensic Medicine in Warsaw, there he had one of his men, Grzegorz Cichocki whom he helped disappear for 2 months (the novels don’t really explain if he’s the part of Sons of the Light or just paid off, what was known was the fact that he knew him). Grzegorz took Olga out of the department when Iwo paid the Deputy Voivode to get his boss out of Warsaw, so he wouldn’t notice.

“Przewieszenie”
1st kill

He walked into a shelter in the Gąsienicowa Valley, he noticed that there’s a lot of tourists even though it wasn’t the peak of the season. The Winter wasn’t strong, Iwo came from Zawrat, there wasn’t much snow near the climb, so it wasn’t worth even putting on crampons but for safety he pulled out a pickax’ which he used only twice. He wasn’t just there for pierogi, he was looking for prey. He knew that the majority will spend the night there but some people will definitely want to try to get back to Kuźnice. He pulled out a map and started acting like he was planning a journey and discreetly looking for an interested look from one of the tourists, he noticed a shy girl smiling at him. He approached her and started to talk, he already had a script prepared for questions like “what do you do for a living”. He without any issue took control of the conversation and got her sympathy. As she left to the bathroom, leaving her backpack under his protection, he put inside an empty pack of Big Red gums and a charm with a Circle of Dharma. Her name was Paulina Jasińska and came from Kraków, he introduced himself as Iwo but asked her to call him Eliasz. Paulina asked him if he made a reservation for a room, he answered he did not. Iwo obviously knew that you need a reservation cause you can’t just sleep on the floor due to the rules in this shelter. Iwo gave her some info about the path she was about to take, leaving out the warning about a true horror for the people scared of the abyss because he knew that she won't live long enough to see it.

During the trip Iwo walked in front of his victim, even though he would prefer to walk behind her, there are rules to hiking and one of them is that the most experienced person leads the rest. They were 1900 meters high, not counting few tourists nobody was there with them, Paulina asked if they could make a stop to which Iwo agreed, he planned to kill her at a height of 2000 meters or above, the exposition was getting larger and larger, and the rocks were getting sharper and rawer, which meant that her body will in his words “it will tear apart wonderfully”. They let the other tourists pass further, after a small conversation they resumed hiking, for a while they traveled hand in hand but at some point Iwo let her go forwards, she didn’t complain even though she should. The section was getting sharper and when Paulina asked him to go first he got closer to her and hit her, grabbed her hair and swung her head against a rock, then Iwo swung her head in another direction. She screamed as she fell down the mountain into the abyss. Then he put on a mask and started screaming “HELP”, another tourist approached him and they made the decision together to call
TOPR

TOPR took Paulina’s body and one lifeguard started to talk with Eliasz and the other tourist. Eliasz told him that they had seen how she died, he used the word “they” in order to make the tourist with him feel like he was the part of the situation and as a result he provided Iwo an alibi. Eliasz gave the lifeguard a fake ID. Iwo knew that the case of her death will go to a newbie prosecutor to determine if that’s an accident of murder and expected that this newbie will check the name on his ID and see that he wasn’t accused of any crime and if he checks the ID number he won’t find him cause the ID isn’t stolen it’s forged. He knew that nobody would look closer at Paulina’s death, cause for everybody it would be obvious, a girl fell down and 2 witnesses saw that happening. Iwo walked away, to find another victim.

2nd kill

Iwo headed towards a shelter in the Valley of Five Ponds, where tourists could sleep on the floor and he had the money, but he didn’t want to leave unnecessary traces. He knew that at some point somebody will realise that those deaths aren’t just accidents but a result of a murder. He shaved off his beard so if TOPR lifeguards had to describe him, those descriptions wouldn’t match. He doesn’t view his actions as wrong, just a part of laws of nature. He was wondering how long will it take the police to realise and more importantly, what will Wiktor Forst think about this whole thing. A boy approached him and they started a conversation. Eliasz knew that at this hour the only tourists present were those who intended to sleep in the shelters, those who understand each other and are in solidarity with each other. The conversation moved to a girl who fell near Świnica, Eliasz knew that he was talking about Paulina and mixed up the places where the death took place but didn’t correct him. When the boy said that this mountain is a reaper Eliasz made a mistake of quoting a poem “Mountains are beyond good and evil” but he managed to correct it by saying it’s from a movie. After a while the conversation went towards the topic of women, Iwo noticed that every conversation usually goes towards that topic. They went inside the shelter and introduced themselves, the boy’s name was Szymon and Iwo used a fake name prepared earlier. They engaged in a small talk, bragged about their achievements and their plans for future trips like Iwo’s trip to Slovakia which happens later in the story. The next day Iwo learned that Szymon doesn’t travel alone but with 2 other people, the day before he planned with Szymon that they will go through Świnica to Kasprowy and there they will stop for dinner, however Iwo planned to get to Kasprowy alone. Iwo started to determine if he can kill all of the 3. If he somehow managed to ditch one of them he could easily go last and shove 1 of them off the mountain and as the 2nd is in shock shove him too. 3 people were too much of a risk. They were getting closer to Wyżnie Solisko. Eliasz thought about turning back and changing victims, that wasn’t something he couldn’t give up. However the last night he placed in his backpack an empty pack of Big Red gums, Eliasz noticed that the shoes they wore are from the cheaper end of what Decathlon sells. There was a chance they’ll turn back when they see approach to Zawrat, so Iwo decided to follow the plan. When faced with what’s further ahead they decided to stop for a while. Iwo asked if they wanted to continue, and they said yes, much to Iwo’s annoyance with their stupidity. The girl pointed out that on the slope there’s a bit of snow. Iwo used the opportunity and said that with crampons they will succeed. Iwo noticed from their eyes that they don’t have them and that they most likely don’t know what he’s talking about. Iwo noticed that they don’t even have proper shoes to put on crampons. He wanted to kill them and would do that if he didn’t already choose the victim and left inside his bag an omen of what’s about to come. They decided to keep moving forward, if anything the duo without crampons will just turn back. When they found themselves before the pass, Iwo grabbed Szymon’s backpack and threw him off the mountain while yelling “CAREFUL!”. Iwo knew that there was a small possibility that the TOPR lifeguard that will show up will be the same one he spoke to after the last murder. TOPR has around 200-300 lif,eguards, these statistics were unreliable because some lifeguards got this title for their whole life, so even though they don’t operate they are still accounted for. Those active have a duty of working 120 hours per year. Eliasz couldn’t acquire information of what system of posts TOPR uses, so he couldn’t determine if the same lifeguard will show up. There were only 30 professional lifeguards after all. Logically that lifeguard shouldn’t work two days in a row but Iwo prefers to have better foundations for his conclusions. Iwo told the pair he was hiking with that he is gonna check if he survived while acting frightened and told them to call TOPR. The problem was taken care of, when TOPR lifeguard came the pair said that there was another tourist who saw what happened and went down to check, but nobody will look for him. Iwo came to the conclusion that he worried more than he should. After making sure the job was done Iwo went towards the Valley of Five Ponds, on the way he met two lifeguards, he informed them of what happened. Iwo knew that when that couple tells them that there was another tourist who came down to check, the lifeguards will mentally note down that they met him. In another shelter Iwo took out a clean piece of paper and started writing “I am not a psychopath, I don’t sit with my victim’s bodies, I don’t enjoy the smell of death. I kill to live. I am not a psychopath, I am an artist and the public of my own pieces and I don’t share them with anybody…”

Iwo was planning to head to Rysy the next day. He hoped that the weather wouldn't be too good because he didn’t want to lay off his work for the next day. A tourist sitting next to him in a shelter on Morskie Oko started a conversation, Iwo learned from him that his friend said that an avalanche happened near the Valley of Five Ponds and it took one lifeguard. Iwo really doubted the last part since TOPR lifeguards usually were very ambitious about the mountains but they were respectful of their force. When Iwo asked the tourist how does his friend know that, to which he responded that his friend saw that guy talking to a lifeguard as if they were planning something but what interested Eliasz was that he claims that the man wore a red and black checked shirt which Forst wears a lot and since not a lot of people goes into the mountains in red and black checked shirts. Iwo told the tourist that he might know that guy and asked him to call his friend. When Iwo learned from him that the man was a commissioner he was sure that it was Forst, then he quickly realised that if he was on a closed trail near the Valley of Five Ponds then he most likely wanted to quickly get to Morskie Oko and that meant it’s possible Forst suspects that he is there. Iwo was sure that was the case, but also angry that he was taken by an avalanche. Iwo knew that Forst’s chances were slim, if he managed to create a pocket of air he could survive for 15-18 minutes. He knew that without a chopper TOPR will send lifeguards from the shelters. 2 from the Gąsienicowa Valley to Black Pond and that they will be there after 20 minutes, maybe earlier. It would also be easier for the lifeguards if they knew where to look, the best scenario would be if Forst had an avalanche detector but Iwo knew Forst inside out and knew that he didn’t rent it before going into the mountains. Even though many modern tourist j,ackets have them built in, Iwo supposed that Wiktor took old clothing with him. He was also sure that Forst didn’t have a buoyancy backpack, a backpack that has two airbags which increases the chance of survival by 90%.

Framing of Wiktor Forst and Agata Kidnapping

If you paid attention to the details you have noticed that Iwo placed in his 1st and 2nd victim’s bags Big Red packs he either stole from Wiktor Forst’s apartment of from his trash, so the justice system can analyse them and find Wiktor’s fingerprints (Big Red is not sold in Poland, it can however be imported), Iwo knew that Wiktor chews these in order to fight his smoking addiction and that he is a loner which means that he most likely spends his nights alone and that means that he wouldn’t have an alibi for all his kills. That allowed Iwo to make Wiktor the prime suspect in the investigation and that the prosecution would take these deaths as the killer deciding to laugh into the justice system’s face by leaving them as circumstantial evidence.

Eliasz disguised as a police officer went to the flat of Agata Osica, Wiktor’s ex-girlfriend. He prepared a fake police ID and explained the lack of the uniform with the mobilisation of all forces which did take place. When the opportunity presented itself he knocked her out after she let him in, then he put in a note for Wiktor Forst in the “Bangkok 8” book, cut out a circle of Dharma in Agata’s chest, and sent the picture to Osica using her phone. Afterwards he left through the terrace.

The note contained a bunch of lies that a person that knows the case on the surface level would buy and info where the note was written ‘Morskie Oko (1346 m.a.s.l) but the height was wrong on purpose in order to point Forst towards Štrbské Lake, another place in Tatry, just on the Slovakian side.

Eliasz didn’t kill Agata himself, he used one of his henchmen Łukasz Bortnowski who up to that point took care of his ‘tenant’ in Rabka-Zdrój while Iwo was doing other things. Eliasz predicted that after Forst finds Agata he would go to the nearest shelter and from there go to Predné Solisko because no trail leads there and since the Beast isn’t just a tourist he will be able to get up there. There Eliasz placed on a sign a gum next to a word Satan. Eliasz told Łukasz that after he kills Agata they will meet on Satan and continue achieving the next goals of Sons of the Light and he believed him, from that point it was easy for Eliasz to kill him. It didn’t matter if Forst got onto Satan cause Eliasz would be long gone. I know that because in the last chapter Eliasz himself mentions that he wanted Forst to see what he has planned for later and in prison he might die before it gets on the news. Eliasz supposed that the case may go to CBŚ (Central Bureau of Investigation) and after what he has planned to the Agency of Internal Safety. Iwo expressed how sorry he is for Forst that he most likely won’t get to see what he planned and expected him to clear his name.

Disappearance of Gjord Hansen

Over the course of the story he was leading conversations with his wife Dominika Wadryś-Hansen about the case, he suggested that it could be a political case and told her he knows a Deputy Voivode, few days later he told her that according to him somebody deliberately took off Forst and other cops off the case, and that nobody is investigating it because it may end badly for that person who does and that someone high has to be responsible. Later Gjord has been destroying his relationship with Dominika and telling her that she’s a bad person because she’s acting childish and a bad mother because she never spends time with her kids which results in her being more like an aunt. By the end he disappeared while leaving a note that he can’t live with her anymore and that the relationship is beyond saving and that he returned to his home country and wrote down that he will pay child support. Gjord knew Dominika would from the past experience with him come to the conclusion that it’s out of character, that he wouldn’t leave his children and look into changes in the provincial office which he caused in order to push one of his men to Warsaw. Dominika later found out that the Deputy Voivode that Gjord knew disappeared.

Before the story started: Iwo planted one of his men in Podgórze in order to spy and protect Forst from death. When Syrian refugees entered Poland, under a nickname “Tiszbita” referencing Eliasz from Tishbe he used Tor Browser which passes the entire traffic through anonymous proxies and a temporary account to which the IP was assigned to and got deleted. On Facebook he did leave traces however they were unusable because he used Whonix which creates a bunch of virtual computers which makes it impossible to fish out the real one. Well… at least not quickly. He gathered the group of 200 people or so who were against taking in refugees. Iwo organised them to come to Zakopane to strike fear into those refugees, he knew that the majority of the people in the group would all bark no bite and that only few people would actually show up. After that incident happened Iwo located one of the people that did show up, somebody that could be remembered as one of the participants and killed him on Kościelisko in such a way that the most logical conclusion would be that somebody decided to copy the Beast’s M.O. but made it look purposefully sloppy. He removed the victim’s documents, money, heck even the coupons and cut off his fingertips, broke his teeth and then left a Syrian coin in his mouth.

Iwo located a guard on Podgórze, where Wiktor Forst was sent to as the killer of the Łowotar. Iwo asked him if he can do something for him there, after the guard told him that for making such propositions he could face legal consequences Iwo quickly changed his mind by sending him 1000zł and an email asking him if he got the package and that he wants to pull a prank of one of the inmates, then he sent him perfumes Kenzo Amour and told him to spray a sponge sent to Wiktor Forst with it and pack it again. Then he told this guard to delete the emails. Iwo did that in order to indirectly tell him that Olga is alive and to trigger in him a need to leave the arrest. Following it up with an unregistered letter from Chełm a day later “Forgive her for not getting up.” alluding to the message written down on Olga’s grave, mocking the commissioner.
Before the events of the book even began Iwo managed to manipulate Olga Szrebska into Stockholm syndrome and let her go abroad. Replacing her with another woman he kidnapped.

Iwo left Carrefour and headed towards Tetmajer street. He estimated a march there would take him 30 minutes, he wasn’t wrong. There at his house he met his “tenant”. Iwo told her to look at him, she did that quickly because Eliasz taught her that it's profitable. He rewarded her for good behaviour by letting her watch TV, once he even brought a bottle of wine. That was a mistake, since she poured half of it into herself, before he took it from her. He had to punish her, which didn’t bring him any joy since he prefers psychic damage. Iwo thought that obedience would give him joy but he was disappointed. It wasn’t enough. Iwo even after his tenant stopped trying to kill herself kept checking if she could try to kill herself with a product he bought. She tried to lower his guard multiple times by pretending to be beaten but Iwo didn’t fall for it a single time. He knew that she wasn’t lying when she said she’s done with trying to kill herself since if she really wanted she would ram into the TV, with enough luck she would succeed, and she knew that. Iwo let her watch TV for an hour but after she strips, he bought her black and red checked shirts to wear. She knew to not rush it cause last time she did he turned on a looped sound file full volume. She had to spend 12 hours listening to the screams of women. Iwo tended to "inconvenience" her in multiple ways, he burned her with lighters, put salt on open wounds but he realised that the method doesn’t matter, obedience was the result of consistency. What was important was humiliation, taking away dignity. She did exactly what he wanted, he achieved Stockholm syndrome, and he wasn’t satisfied.

Iwo sent one of his men to kill Michał Sznajderman in prison to avoid a possibility that he betrays him and reveals the truth, even though he has been loyal. Iwo leaked information that in a primary school to which he gave an address fully knowing that extremists will go there to protest and riot. Iwo left for Ukraine to pay off one of the Ukrainians to testify that he saw Olga Szrebska shoot Witalij Morawczuk in order to put Forst back on his trail. After that he gave an order to one of the rioters to set the school in flames in order to make it possible for another to kill one of the refugees without his involvement. Framing another refugee for these murders and trying to make it seem like the Beast at the same time.

Iwo created a website and advertised himself as a guide while providing false certificates and false reviews, each one written differently but beneficial to him. He chose two people who rented him out, set up a meeting and removed the website. He knew that nothing disappears from the internet and that somebody would find it but it didn’t matter to him cause he just wanted people to stop calling him. They met at 5:30 at the station. It was obvious to him that they were going hiking for the first time. Otherwise, they would have realized right away that something was wrong. Most of the guides drove their own cars, as regulations allowed them to park all the way in Włosienica. This way, tourists didn't have to walk the long distance along the asphalt road towards Morskie Oko. They were called Anna and Robert, it didn’t matter. The only thing that did matter was that Iwo gets to send a message, the kind that doesn’t leave any room of interpretation. Beast Of Giewont is back. And all thanks to that Anna and Robert wanted to save 80zł cause that’s how much Iwo’s service was cheaper than those of the other guides. Iwo learned that they only went through basic training, which meant that they decided to climb onto Monk way too soon, natural selection at its finest. They went through the west side of the Monk. Iwo had to return the honor, they knew the theory and most likely participated in a similar expedition but checked their ropes either way cause he didn’t want them to fall this quickly. During the climb they have stopped at a rock ledge. Iwo told them to take off their helmets and go ahead of him, then Iwo grabbed the man by his head and slammed it against the rocks and took down the girl. Then he left coins in their mouths. One of the coins had alpha and 22 and the 2nd had omega and 13. In order to keep up the narrative of a copycat and to tell them that he’s not happy with someone copying him.

Iwo knew that Wiktor Forst would investigate the trail he himself gave him of Olga being alive so he sent an unregistered letter to Grzegorz’s former apartment in which he gave Forst numbers 49,11. 50,20. 02,24 which pointed to Szpiglasty Wierch.

When Iwo found out Dominika Wadryś-Hansen wanted to perform an exhumation of Olga Szrebska’s grave he called the Deputy Voivode he used to remove supervision of Grzegorz to stop it. Iwo did that to prolong the time it would take to open the coffin in order to raise the stakes. Iwo kidnapped a 5 year old boy on Morskie Oko leaving a coin there and took him to the place he was holding his tenant in. Beforehand he left a message to Forst on Szpiglasty Wierch, a wooden stake with “I can do all things through Him who strengthens me.” written on it.

Iwo killed another refugee on Kościelisko, Amira was the woman who was giving Dominika information about what was happening after they entered Poland. He left a message on her phone and a coin with INRI written on the obverse and with the symbol of Giewont on the reverse. INRI meant “Iesus Nazarenus Rex Iudaeorum” - “Jesus of Nazareth, King of the Jews” to tell the investigators that the circle is closed.

“I lived in the wilderness, I was in the desert, I received the beginning of the mission. Malachi foretold my second coming. And here I am.
